title: Functional vs non-functional requirements
description: Learn about Functional vs non-functional requirements. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Functional vs non-functional requirements** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with functional vs non-functional requirements.

items: Understand the core differences between functional and non-functional requirements
Know when to choose functional over non-functional requirements
Recognize the trade-offs involved in each approach
Apply the right tool for the specific problem context

data.text: Understanding functional vs non-functional requirements is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with functional vs non-functional requirements, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
